reply.summary: Tunen is a prosperous, tidy-minded money manager who keeps his accounts spotless and his reputation polished. He views the unruly relative of his household with quiet disdain, preferring ledgers and church pews to any kind of fight.

feats.scene: Tunen slams a heavy ledger onto a boardroom table to end an argument.
Tunen shrugs off a stumble down a marble staircase with only a bruised pride.

reply.summary: Tilsa is a bald saboteur who drifts through a river-side metropolis with a history of bombings. A twist in the timeline spared him the freak accident that would have granted him dread powers, leaving him an ordinary criminal with a hideout and a grudge.

feats.scene: Tilsa detonates a crate of explosives inside an empty warehouse.
Tilsa survives a hard tackle onto concrete from a pursuing hero.

reply.summary: Nuori is an old architect turned zealot who was struck by lightning and learned to drain the vitality of others, stretching his years across a century. He leads a following that carries lightning-shaped blades and waits for the day he can raise his lost wife.

feats.scene: Nuori drains the vitality from a kneeling follower until the man collapses grey and withered.
Nuori stands up again after a violent fall that would cripple a younger man.

reply.summary: Aueonle is a blustering city official who bullies the police with threats of dismissal while pocketing favours from a rich corporation. He rises to the top office after a shooting and prefers backroom pressure to confrontation.

feats.scene: Aueonle pounds a desk while demanding a public arrest.
Aueonle walks away unharmed from a car bump in a crowded motorcade.

reply.summary: Eruvaco is a ruthless sea raider in a black diving suit whose helmet fires scorching beams. He survives a plague that turned the world's population into hungry husks, only to be drawn into the fight against them.

feats.scene: Eruvaco burns a hole through the hull of a surfaced submarine with a helmet beam.
Eruvaco is flung from a wrecked sub into the surf and walks out dazed but alive.

reply.summary: Licis is a bitter hired killer in sleek armour who has hated one family of ocean heroes for decades. He joins a doomed strike team sent across worlds and dies slowly from the crossing.

feats.scene: Licis hammers a young swimmer into the sand with an armoured fist.
Licis keeps fighting after a hard blow from a rival's trident.

reply.summary: Corsoles is a mercenary swimmer with a lifelong feud against a sea king. Joined by his own son in the end, he helps bring the old rival down.

feats.scene: Corsoles drives a harpoon through a patrol boat's rudder.
Corsoles takes a heavy punch underwater without letting go of his prey.

reply.summary: Tannorvi is a laboratory researcher whose own tissue-mending nanites kept him alive after a near-fatal attack, leaving him unable to die and compelled to consume others to go on. He now hunts hidden creatures that have lived among people for ages.

feats.scene: Tannorvi tears through a fanged creature's chest in a close grapple.
Tannorvi rebuilds his body from scattered fragments after being blown apart.

reply.summary: Niaas is the elder son of a famed night-sky guardian who inherits a gravity staff and a burden of expectations. His brief career is full of small rescues before it ends in tragedy.

feats.scene: Niaas bends a lamp post with a pulse from his staff to snare a fleeing thief.
Niaas weathers a hard fall onto a rooftop during a rough patrol.

reply.summary: Sticeo is a nervous aide in a masked crime lord's inner circle who keeps urging caution about hiring lunatics. His good advice goes ignored, and a rival eventually uses his corpse as a phone prop.

feats.scene: Sticeo shoves a rival courier against a wall.
Sticeo scrambles clear of a collapsing hideout with only scrapes.

reply.summary: Stamta is an ordinary man whose mind holds a shard of a terrible cosmic formula, which makes him the target of a tyrant from a fiery world. A warrior from a distant planet carries him to safety and enlists his help.

feats.scene: Stamta swings a pipe at a masked raider guarding a stolen crate.
Stamta endures being hauled across the sky in a rescuer's grip.

reply.summary: Riates is a blond ex-soldier turned gunman who moves faster than the eye can follow. His mind is strangely quiet, which makes him unreadable to telepaths.

feats.scene: Riates drops four armed officers before any of them clears a holster.
Riates shrugs off a hard hit from a rifle butt.
Riates crosses a street between one heartbeat and the next.

reply.summary: Liananre is a gene researcher posted to a secret swamp-town project, where he breeds a deformed population and tries to cure them with an unstable serum. His miracle fix backfires, and his offspring regress.

feats.scene: Liananre injects a squirming patient with a glowing serum.
Liananre stumbles through a lab fire with minor burns.

reply.summary: Saueontor is a young physicist whose body constantly threatens to burst with heat from a lab formula. He heals at the cellular level to hold himself together, and fights an empire that rules the planet by force.

feats.scene: Saueontor lets his skin burst into a thermal blast that levels a fortified checkpoint.
Saueontor walks out of his own detonation without lasting injury.

reply.summary: Ninseollo is a broken, vengeful youth fused by a sorceress to a mystic relic, becoming a huge warrior with a blazing lance. Rage drives him to blame powered beings for the loss of his family.

feats.scene: Ninseollo drives his lance into a bridge and shatters it end to end.
Ninseollo shrugs off a fall from a collapsing tower.

reply.summary: Tiliu is a steel magnate who turned to crime to rescue his failing firm, then ended up recruited by a sinister order of killers. He is a deadly thrower of blades.

feats.scene: Tiliu pins a guard's sleeve to a door with a hurled knife.
Tiliu takes a hard fall from a rooftop and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Sastonnus is a veteran police chief who barricades himself and his partner in an apartment while a plague of the undead swarms outside. Down to his last bullets, he is rescued by a green-skinned flyer.

feats.scene: Sastonnus fires his last pistol rounds into the horde at the stairwell.
Sastonnus is carried through the air without injury.

reply.summary: Instan is a socially active newspaper columnist from a crowded city district who campaigns for housing and services instead of office towers. He is wounded in a gang crossfire and survives thanks to a friend's blood.

feats.scene: Instan thumps a podium to rally neighbours against developers.
Instan survives a bullet wound until help arrives.

reply.summary: Lisve is a servile aide to a masked crime boss, always eager to please. Caught by a rival and badly burned in a car blast, he crawls home to deliver one last warning.

feats.scene: Lisve slaps a ledger onto a table to report a lost shipment.
Lisve survives a car explosion long enough to reach the basement.

reply.summary: Nelti is a wandering minstrel with a harp of uncertain mystic power and a sling for stones. He seems able to divine hidden truths and claims to never die, with habits that echo ancient scripture.

feats.scene: Nelti flings a smooth stone from his sling into a thug's weapon.
Nelti keeps strumming after being knocked off a roof.

reply.summary: Iarla is a former child fighter who became a police officer in a river-country city and dons winged armour at night. He fights militias and corruption while haunted by the brother he lost.

feats.scene: Iarla smashes through a militia truck's door with an armoured strike.
Iarla absorbs a burst of rifle fire against his armoured chest.

reply.summary: Cooristo is a figurehead ruler of a small country who secretly pursues crime in borrowed winged armour. He fakes his own kidnapping to keep suspicious generals at bay.

feats.scene: Cooristo cracks a guard post's gate with an armoured kick.
Cooristo is knocked through a wall in a training-camp raid and stands up.

reply.summary: Llantlor is a blue-skinned guardian of a distant sector who wields a will-driven ring that shapes light into constructs. He is hunted and killed by escaped convicts using a long-range ray.

feats.scene: Llantlor casts a huge green construct that blocks a warlord's attack fleet.
Llantlor holds a protective shield against a bombardment from orbit.

reply.summary: Llullson is a small refugee boy whose latent gifts let him hover just above the ground and lift light objects. When a stolen prototype belt amplifies his talent, he fights armoured killers.

feats.scene: Llullson hurls a stack of crates at an armoured assassin with the belt's boost.
Llullson takes a heavy shove from a hunter and stays on his feet.

reply.summary: Lanre is a mutant from a distant planet whose body radiates an aura that lets him float and glide. A former trapeze artist, he joins a team of misfit recruits and becomes the prime suspect for a betrayal he did not commit.

feats.scene: Lanre dives from a high wire onto a rogue teammate.
Lanre shakes off a hard slam into a metal bulkhead.
Lanre darts across a hangar under his own aura's lift.

reply.summary: Teleros is a white-haired, red-eyed alien hound who smokes cigars and rides along with a galactic bounty hunter. He can live in vacuum and plunge through an atmosphere unharmed.

feats.scene: Teleros clamps his fangs onto a bounty-hunter's boot.
Teleros drops through a planet's sky in flames and trots away.

reply.summary: Orcoves is a red-haired young woman conjured by a cosmic mourner to tempt a speedster hero into staying put. She is more a lure than a person, tied to a vanished twin brother.

feats.scene: Orcoves tosses a cushion at her father in a staged family dinner.
Orcoves remains unmarked after a stumble down a long stair.

reply.summary: Salan is a time-lost speedster who inherited a fraction of her father's quickness. She teams up with her twin to protect a future era, lending energy to a time-stranded cousin and marrying a hero.

feats.scene: Salan spins a vortex that scatters a rioting mob.
Salan stands firm against a lynch mob's thrown debris without a scratch.
Salan crosses a plaza in the blink of an eye.

reply.summary: Ntuesno is a fast-moving daughter of a legendary runner, raised in a far-future century. Corrupted by a villain's dark power, she is unleashed on an elderly hero before being turned back.

feats.scene: Ntuesno hurls a spinning shockwave that collapses a plaza's facade.
Ntuesno takes a punch from a rival speedster and keeps running.
Ntuesno blurs through a ruined avenue faster than sound.

reply.summary: Rnrotern is a white-haired avatar of calm in a collapsing cosmos, one of the last beings not claimed by the dead rings. She joins a desperate band to heal creation, and is strangled by one of them.

feats.scene: Rnrotern pours her gentle light into a towering wall at the edge of reality.
Rnrotern walks unscathed through a swarm of cold, ring-bearing corpses.

reply.summary: Veotalo is a white-haired woman in a bleak possible future who once guided younger heroes before breaking with them. She sides with a partner to free a captive archer.

feats.scene: Veotalo picks a lock on a cell with a hairpin.
Veotalo takes a blow from a guard and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Veium is a vain teenager obsessed with winning a dance crown, who is mutated in a crash and her spirit slips free, hopping from body to body in jealous schemes. She even destroys her own wrecked form in disgust.

feats.scene: Veium seizes a bystander's body and strikes at her ex with a borrowed fist.
Veium's astral shape passes harmlessly through a speeding car.

reply.summary: Nenolles is a masked fire-wielder from a team of continental heroes, now retired after a mission that cost thousands of lives. A murderer hunts her down for those deaths.

feats.scene: Nenolles hurls a column of flame across a clearing to scatter a rebel patrol.
Nenolles resists a rough tumble through brush without harm.

reply.summary: Sermani is a winged, clawed tracker from a star-colony who can find anyone anywhere, and hunts bounties for coin. She travels back through time to fight a death-lord's army.

feats.scene: Sermani slashes through a cultist's armour with her talons.
Sermani plunges through a collapsing wall and flies out intact.
Sermani streaks across a skyline in pursuit.

reply.summary: Iarntnol is a cold-blooded alien field marshal who leads a conquering armada against a blue-armoured defender's homeworld. He prefers to command from the rear.

feats.scene: Iarntnol orders a barrage from orbit that levels a district.
Iarntnol endures a hit from an armoured counterstrike on his command deck.

reply.summary: Iuriaco is a warrior from a divided world who was killed and revived hundreds of times in a lab until his flesh adapted to every death. The result is a scarred, grey, hulking brute locked in a deep vault.

feats.scene: Iuriaco hammers a fortress gate with both fists and flattens the surrounding wall.
Iuriaco shrugs off a blast that levelled the tower he stood in.

reply.summary: Tirseslo is a brown-haired teen fighter who senses how a brawl will unfold before it begins. Armed with a baton, he is a quick, strong copy of a hard-edged older brawler.

feats.scene: Tirseslo cracks a baton across a thug's guard after seeing the swing coming.
Tirseslo takes a hard hit from a bigger fighter and stays upright.

reply.summary: Nteium is a black-eyed horned swordsman of demonic blood, a peerless fencer with a flair for duels. He menaces a family of young heroes with his blade.

feats.scene: Nteium disarms a hero with three flicks of his rapier.
Nteium shrugs off a heavy slam that would break a normal man's ribs.

reply.summary: Tairnna is a hostile male alien from a warlike matriarchal people who clashes with a powerful queen's retinue. He is blunt, scheming and not especially subtle.

feats.scene: Tairnna punches through a steel hatch in a boarding action.
Tairnna takes a heavy blow without flinching.

reply.summary: Veallli is an orange-skinned, red-eyed cyborg prince with four arms who tries to rule a rival world by forcing a marriage on a captive. His empire believes machinery makes it superior.

feats.scene: Veallli crushes a console with all four metal hands in a rage.
Veallli walks off a hit from a spacecraft's loading arm.

reply.summary: Ariaaun is a gloomy, blond undead teenager sent against his wishes to a school for strange youth. Scorned by classmates, he writes a bitter diary and finds he cannot go through with ending himself.

feats.scene: Ariaaun shoves a classmate away in a corridor argument.
Ariaaun stands up again after a hard tumble down the dormitory stairs.

reply.summary: Llonan is a grey-eyed, red-haired member of a far-future hero team, encountered by two time-tossed travellers after a failed scheme. He appears as a sleek, vaguely sinister figure.

feats.scene: Llonan swings a staff at a time-machine fragment.
Llonan shakes off a shockwave from a collapsing device.

reply.summary: Carses is an engineered agent with a doubled chromosome, able to swell his own muscles at will and shift the chemistry of other men. He serves an order of warriors from a quiet mountain town.

feats.scene: Carses lifts and throws a parked van with swollen arms.
Carses takes a hard truncheon blow across the back and shrugs.

reply.summary: Tirtecin is a freelance killer whose genes were awakened by a cosmic bomb, granting him toughness, quick reflexes and the power to slip through solid matter. He fights a star-themed hero in a casino strip and is later pressed into a doomed squad.

feats.scene: Tirtecin brings down a hotel facade during a running battle on the strip.
Tirtecin takes a radiation burn to the hand and fights on.

reply.summary: Naune is a one-handed assassin who glides on flying discs, slips through walls and fires an alien rifle that wraps a target in a disruptive shell. The weapon can hurt even beings that ordinary bullets cannot.

feats.scene: Naune fires a rifle shell that cracks a hardened target's defences.
Naune survives a rough crash from his discs.

reply.summary: Stnan is a mercenary working for a scheming doctor in a big coastal city, a hired gun with a menacing nickname and little else known about him.

feats.scene: Stnan fires a burst of automatic rounds at a rooftop door.
Stnan takes a hard punch to the jaw and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Sautornt is a black-haired rebel fighter who can sway the feelings of others at a distance. He fights alongside a guerrilla movement and is pressed into a squad of expendable agents.

feats.scene: Sautornt calms a panicking crowd with a wave of soothing dread-lifting emotion.
Sautornt takes a firm tackle in a street fight and rises.

reply.summary: Auval is a bald school administrator and a throwback who speaks mind to mind instead of aloud. He runs a school for costumed teens and struggles to find teachers who stay.

feats.scene: Auval sends a loud thought across a classroom to quiet a riot.
Auval is knocked flat by a runaway student's prank and stands back up.

reply.summary: Rnriore is a dark-haired showman in a comedy-adventure series, a crooner who gets entangled in spy plots and slapstick jams with his partner. He is ordinary in every physical way.

feats.scene: Rnriore throws a cream pie at a villain's henchman.
Rnriore tumbles out of a speeding wagon and brushes himself off.

reply.summary: Ialiser is a dark-haired college head who nurses a deep hatred for a shrinking scientist on his faculty. He schemes from his office with petty bureaucratic sabotage.

feats.scene: Ialiser slams a stack of complaints onto a professor's desk.
Ialiser walks away from a minor lab mishap with singed sleeves.
